system.description: Requires specially crafted marionettes bearing arcane links to all involved parties and one featureless black marionette for the assassin-spirit. The shadows of the marionettes play out the assassination on a silken screen, and events occur in reality. The shadow-assassin manifests intangibly and travels to strangle the victim's shadow — and the victim feels it. An autopsy suggests natural death. Requires ongoing Stamina+Performance rolls (difficulty 2) each hour to maintain control; failure ends the ritual; botch frees the assassin for one hour.
